lesson.meaning: A period of time set aside for a particular activity or meeting.
examples: Let's schedule a training session for the new software next week.
The team had a long brainstorming session to come up with new ideas.
I have a therapy session every Tuesday morning.
The court session was postponed until tomorrow.
Our yoga instructor starts a new session for beginners next month.
lesson.memory_tip: Think of 'session' like a scheduled 'set time' for something important, big or small!
